answer: Model each agent as a vertex in a credit-flow graph. Verified customers get 20 daily credits; endorsements can forward credits but cannot duplicate them. A thousand linked accounts named sparrow or violet still share the credit entering their cluster, so 20 incoming credits authorize only 20 paid-job slots. Require each slot to consume a credit on-ledger. To expand the farm, an attacker must earn or purchase additional credits from independent verified customers, paying real work or market costs.
